yesno.metaDescription: Draw one or three cards for a Yes, No or Maybe hint on your question. For guidance and entertainment.
yesno.question: Question
yesno.questionPlaceholder: E.g. Should I talk to them directly this week?
yesno.tip: Ask about something you can act on soon, one question at a time. Avoid "A or B" (draw separately for each option).
samples: Should I message them first today?
Should I say how I feel this week?
Should I give this relationship more time?
Should I accept the new job offer?
Should I start a new course this month?
Is today a good day to start something new?
yesno.repeatNotice: Drawing again and again to find an answer you like drains the meaning from the cards. Your first draw is the one to trust.

yes.line: The card leans toward "Yes". The energy supports this direction.

no.line: The card leans toward "No". Something is blocking this or it isn't a fit right now.

maybe.line: The card doesn't lean either way. There may be missing information, or you may not have decided yet.

later.line: It could be a "Yes", but it is delayed or blocked. Wait a little or prepare more.

yesno.strengthStrong: Major Arcana: a strong answer with a big-picture direction.
yesno.strengthQualified: Minor Arcana: a qualified answer that depends on your circumstances.
yesno.majorityNote: Majority of three cards: {yes} lean Yes, {no} lean No, {other} unclear or not yet.
yesno.sensitive: Your question may touch on health, money or legal matters. Tarot is for guidance and entertainment only and does not replace a professional. For important decisions, ask a qualified person.
yesno.crisis: I hear that you are carrying a lot. Tarot is not the right place to answer this. Please talk to someone close to you or a professional nearby. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number right away.

say.idle: Think of a Yes or No question, then press "Shuffle and draw".
say.shuffling: Miu is shuffling. Hold your question in mind…
say.revealing: The cards are chosen. Let's flip them!
say.crisis: I'm here with you. Please reach out to someone you trust or a professional.
yes: The card leans "Yes". Wishing you a smooth step!
The energy seems to be on your side.
no: The card says "No". It is only a hint, the choice is still yours.
Not a fit right now. Maybe look at the question again.
maybe: Not so clear. You may need more information.
The card sits in the middle. Listen to your own heart too.
later: Not yet, but not necessarily a no.
Try waiting a little or preparing more.

legal.title: Content notice
legal.entertainment: Miu Tarot is for guidance and entertainment. The cards are prompts for reflection, not certain predictions about the future.
legal.noAdvice: Content is not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice and does not replace a professional. For important decisions, consult a qualified person.
legal.ai: The "In-depth analysis" is assembled from pre-written content based on the cards you draw and your question; it is not generated by AI at viewing time. It is for reference only.
legal.age: The service is for people aged 18 and over.
legal.privacy: The Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are available via the links below.

footer.line2: Tarot is for reference and entertainment and does not replace professional advice.
